notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's guid.rs decodes the 1.12 guid bit layout (high-16 family tags, entry bits 24-47, MO_TRANSPORT full-low-32 entry, pet-number-not-entry rule). MSUI's GuidInfo.cs is a direct port with matching constants and the same Entry() special cases including MO_TRANSPORT and the pet exclusion.
